generated.details: On the far-left window's wooden sill, the plain ivory pillar candle is a solid wax cylinder with a recessed top and short unlit wick.
Beside it, three smooth river stones rest separately on their broad flattened undersides.
On the far upper-left wall beside the window, the woven wall hanging has interlaced cream yarn suspended from a wooden rod with a short fringed hem.
On the near-left floor below the table edge, the cropped woven rug has a flat oatmeal-colored weave and bound edges.
